independent_computation.observed_delta: 4527.5 - 3814.5 = 713.0 additional post-mitigation damage delivered to the manual target under the new value.
independent_computation.method: The golden scenario's input tuple (Syndra level/build, target stats, the custom cast order) is NOT present anywhere in the permitted evidence tree - data/ carries no golden scenario definitions (checked: no 'custom_order', 'manual_target', 'ending_health', or scenario id hit under data/). So the leaf was attacked by inverting the delta against every damage row Syndra's cached wiki text can produce, solving each for the ability power that reproduces 713.0 exactly.

inversion.identity: row_damage = base_at_rank + ap_ratio * AP, mitigated by m(R) = 100/(100+R); at R = 0 (or fully-penetrated MR) m = 1, so an integer post-mitigation delta implies an integer raw row.

solutions.row: W Force of Will rank 5 = 190 + 65% AP
E Scatter the Weak rank 5 = 200 + 60% AP
R Unleashed Power per sphere rank 3 = 160 + 20% AP

inversion.unique_fit: Only the Dark Sphere row lands on an integer AP (690) whose pre-Transcendence value is also exact: 690 / 1.15 = 600 AP. W is rejected outright (804.6154 AP is non-integral, and 0.65 * AP cannot yield the integer 523 for any integer AP). E requires 855 AP whose pre-buff value 743.4783 is not a realizable rounded stat, and the engine rounds AP to an integer before damage (math-foundations Section 5), so an 855 effective AP would have to be an unbuffed stat - which contradicts the scenario being at 120 splinters, where the +15% capstone is unconditionally active. R per-sphere requires an absurd 2765 AP.

independent_computation.conclusion: The change adds exactly one additional rank-5 Dark Sphere cast, priced at the already-Transcendence-buffed ability power (600 base AP x 1.15 = 690 AP) against an effectively 0-magic-resist target (m(0) = 1, so raw == post-mitigation, which is what makes the delta a clean integer). It is NOT a re-pricing of the +15% AP buff itself: a buff that switched on would have scaled every AP-scaling row at once, giving a delta of 0.15 * 600 * (sum of AP ratios over the whole cast list) = 90 * Sigma. Sigma would have to be exactly 7.9222 to land on 713.0, which no combination of Syndra's ratios (Q 0.70, W 0.65, E 0.60, R 0.20/sphere) produces on a plausible cast list, and the buff is evidently already present in the OLD value since 690 - not 600 - is the AP that prices the delta.
independent_computation.ruling_on_game_correctness: One extra Dark Sphere is exactly what the cached wiki text says a 120-splinter Syndra has available: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' At 120 splinters that threshold (and every other one: 60 W true damage, 80 E slow, 100 R execute, 120 +15% AP) is met, so a fight authored at 120 splinters must be able to spend two Dark Sphere charges. A model that priced only one Dark Sphere at 120 splinters was under-counting a sourced Transcendent bonus; the new value restores it. The old value 4527.5 corresponds to a 120-splinter Syndra denied her 40-splinter second charge - a state the wiki does not permit.

confidence_and_limits.strength: The delta inverts to a single, doubly-clean solution (integer effective AP 690 AND exact pre-buff AP 600) on the one ability in Syndra's kit that has a splinter-gated extra-cast mechanic. The three competing rows are arithmetically excluded.
confidence_and_limits.residual_uncertainty: Because the scenario's input tuple is outside the permitted evidence tree, I cannot confirm the scenario's custom cast order literally requested two Dark Spheres. If the custom order enumerated a strict four-cast list and the engine now injects an unrequested fifth cast, the extra sphere would be game-legal but scenario-illegal. Nothing in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md lets me settle that; the verdict is rendered on game-rule correctness, which is what the cached wiki text can adjudicate.
also_checked_and_excluded: R 100-splinter execute: would drive ending health to 0, not 3814.5.
R sphere-count change (r_spheres): one sphere at 690 AP is 160 + 0.20*690 = 298.0; no integer multiple gives 713.
W 60-splinter true damage: at 690 AP the whole true-damage row is (0.12 + 0.02*6.90) * (190 + 0.65*690) = 0.258 * 638.5 = 164.73, far short of 713 and non-integral.

Penetration/mitigation re-ordering: docs/math-foundations.md Section 2.2 fixes the composition as max(0, (R - r_flat)*(1 - r_pct/100)*(1 - p) - f); no reordering of a fixed cast list yields an integer 713.0 shift on a single row.
